selection_method.note: Selection uses only post-freeze canonical inventory metadata/text and canonical IDs. E0.8 outputs were not computed or consulted. The 80 records from the burned E0.7 fresh-blind set are explicitly excluded from non-new strata to avoid direct label reuse.

strata.name: NEW_ONLY
strata.rule: All current records whose canonical_id is absent from prior production run 33971681175.

strata.name: TARGET_TITLE_HASH
strata.rule: From remaining records not used in the burned E0.7 80-record blind set and with target-like research/academic title terms, choose lexicographically smallest SHA256(canonical_id).

strata.name: DETAIL_CUE_HASH
strata.rule: From remaining records not used in the burned E0.7 set and with incomplete detail status or generic external-detail cues, choose lexicographically smallest SHA256(canonical_id).

strata.name: BACKGROUND_HASH
strata.rule: From all remaining records not used in the burned E0.7 set, choose lexicographically smallest SHA256(canonical_id).
